violations.title: RLS not enabled on table
violations.message: Table public.boarding_passes does not have row-level security enabled. Add ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY or include the table in [lint.rules.SEC001].allowlist if it is a public reference table.

violations.title: PostgREST-exposed table readable by a low-trust role
violations.message: Table public.boarding_passes is in the PostgREST-exposed schema public, grants SELECT to anon, authenticated, and has no effective row filter (RLS is disabled) — it is directly readable at GET /rest/v1/boarding_passes by an unauthenticated or any-authenticated request. Enable RLS with a row-scoping policy (or restrict/REVOKE the grant); if the table is intentionally public, allowlist 'public.boarding_passes' in [lint.rules.SEC049]. (SEC001/SEC003/SEC008 each flag a precondition of this in isolation; SEC049 is the conjunction.)
